'''Sashino Shrine''' is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}}. As a [[Religious Corporation]] (宗教法人), there are four such shrines in Japan.

* {{ill|Sashino Shrine (Kasama)|ja|佐志能神社 (笠間市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sashino Shrine (Kasama)}} (さしのうじんじゃ) - Located in {{ill|Kasama|en|Kasama|qid=Q446611|lt=Kasama}}, {{ill|Ibaraki Prefecture|en|Ibaraki Prefecture|qid=Q83273|lt=Ibaraki Prefecture}}. Listed in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Engishiki]] as a minor shrine (式内小社). Classified as a village shrine (村社) under the [[Modern system of Ranked Shinto shrines|modern shrine Ranking system]].
* {{ill|Sashino Shrine (Ishioka Kakio)|ja|佐志能神社 (石岡市柿岡)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sashino Shrine (Ishioka Kakio)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} (さしのじんじゃ) - Located in [[:en:Ishioka|Ishioka]], Kakio, Ibaraki Prefecture. Also listed in the Engishiki as a minor shrine. Classified as a village shrine (村社).
* {{ill|Sashino Shrine|ja|佐志能神社 (石岡市染谷)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sashino Shrine (Ishioka Someya)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q17225838}} (さしのじんじゃ) - Located in Someya and Murakami, Ishioka, Ibaraki Prefecture. Listed in the Engishiki as a minor shrine. Classified as a district shrine (郷社).
